symbols.name: V
symbols.def: The labeled endogenous variables; the total order fixes every deterministic tie break.
symbols.role: Observed-variable index set and branch order.

symbols.name: X
symbols.def: The fixed same-model endogenous alphabets, each with a fixed total order.

symbols.name: G
symbols.def: The permitted directed edges and bidirected latent-source incidences.

symbols.name: S
symbols.def: The mutually independent primitive exogenous sources.

symbols.name: inc
symbols.def: The declared endogenous children of every primitive source.

symbols.name: calM
symbols.def: A model with equations \(X_v=f_v(X_{\operatorname{pa}_G(v)},U_{\operatorname{inc}(v)})\) and product source law \(P_U=\bigotimes_{s\in S}P_s\).

symbols.name: Msc
symbols.def: The single-cycle sparse-source simple-SCM class defined in \(\text{def:model-class}\).

symbols.name: R
symbols.def: Each \(r=(Z,z)\) denotes \(\operatorname{do}(Z=z)\), including \(Z=\varnothing\) for observational data.

symbols.name: J
symbols.def: The number of supplied regimes.

symbols.name: p
symbols.type: symbolic or exact numerical regime-probability vector
symbols.def: Its coordinates are \(p_{r,x}=P_{\mathcal M}(X_{V\setminus Z}=x\mid\operatorname{do}(Z=z))\); in the algorithm they are indeterminates, and in evaluation they are an exact supplied vector.

symbols.name: A
symbols.def: A finite conjunction of assignments to perfect-intervention potential outcomes.

symbols.name: B
symbols.def: A finite conjunction of assignments to perfect-intervention potential outcomes.

symbols.name: q
symbols.def: \(q(\mathcal M)=P_{\mathcal M}(A\cap B)/P_{\mathcal M}(B)\) when \(P_{\mathcal M}(B)>0\), and is undefined otherwise.

symbols.name: T
symbols.def: \(\mathcal T=\prod_{v\in V}\{t_v:\mathcal X_{\operatorname{pa}_G(v)}\to\mathcal X_v\}\), with exogenous arguments represented by the explicit source-state tables.

symbols.name: L
symbols.def: Profiles passing the intervention-wise unique-solution test at every boundary assignment.

symbols.name: Omega
symbols.type: finite family of source-state alphabets and decoding tables
symbols.def: \(\Omega=(\Omega_s,g_s:s\in S)\), where the explicitly listed state \(u_s\in\Omega_s\) supplies the response-table entries at the children \(\operatorname{inc}(s)\), and the combined decoder maps \(u\in\prod_s\Omega_s\) to a profile in \(\mathcal T\).

symbols.name: Theta
symbols.def: \(\Theta=\prod_{s\in S}\Delta(\Omega_s)\); a point \(\theta=(\lambda_{s,u})\) assigns independent masses to the separately labeled source states.

symbols.name: Phi
symbols.def: Each coordinate of \(\Phi(\theta)\) is obtained by enumerating \(u\in\prod_s\Omega_s\), multiplying \(\prod_s\lambda_{s,u_s}\), solving its decoded legal table under the regime, and summing the matching cells.

symbols.name: H
symbols.def: \(H(\theta)=P_\theta(A\cap B)\), computed from the same explicitly decoded source tuples.

symbols.name: K
symbols.def: \(K(\theta)=P_\theta(B)\), computed from the same explicitly decoded source tuples.

symbols.name: Pimg
symbols.def: \(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{feas}}=\Phi(\Theta_{\mathcal L})\), where \(\Theta_{\mathcal L}\) contains exactly the source masses whose positive-mass decoded tuples are legal.

symbols.name: F0
symbols.def: \(\mathcal F_0(p)=\{\theta\in\Theta_{\mathcal L}:\Phi(\theta)=p\}\).

symbols.name: F
symbols.def: \(\mathcal F_+(p)=\{\theta\in\mathcal F_0(p):K(\theta)>0\}\).

symbols.name: C
symbols.def: A finite straight-line circuit \(C=N/D\) over rational constants and symbolic coordinates of \(p\), using addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division, with a universally verified nonzero divisor on \(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{feas}}\) wherever \(\mathcal F_+(p)\neq\varnothing\).

symbols.name: Gamma
symbols.def: A record containing a reached terminal, its original-cycle label, the exact source incidence and source tables, two rational or real-algebraic source-mass vectors, their common menu vector, matched boundary-interface rows, a strict target cross-product, decoded global models, and the recursion trace.

symbols.name: Mminus
symbols.def: The first same-alphabet simple-SCM witness decoded from \(\Gamma\).

symbols.name: Mplus
symbols.def: The second same-alphabet simple-SCM witness decoded from \(\Gamma\).

symbols.name: I
symbols.def: \(I=(V,\mathcal X,G,S,\operatorname{inc},\mathcal R,A,B,\mathcal T,\mathcal L,\Omega,\Phi,H,K)\), with every finite table and polynomial stored explicitly over the rationals and checked against the structural decoder before recursion.

symbols.name: Xi
symbols.def: A stack of ordered subproblems, each carrying world-variable occurrences, original-SCC labels, active event rows, available regime kernels, actual source labels and incidence, a consolidated-district partition, a complete boundary primitive-event interface, explicit legal source tables, a phase counter, and an output-expression stack.

symbols.name: O
symbols.def: An exact comprehensive-elimination component on which the two-copy separator formula is false but no verified element of \(\mathbb Q(p)\) represents \(H/K\).

symbols.name: Alg
symbols.def: The executable ordered transition system in \(\text{def:algorithm-handle}\); it emits one symbolic output uniformly over the full positive feasible menu image rather than taking one numerical \(p\) as an identification input.

symbols.name: Eval
symbols.type: exact circuit evaluator with domain statuses
symbols.def: The evaluator first tests membership in \(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{feas}}\), then nonemptiness of \(\mathcal F_+(p)\), and evaluates \(C(p)\) only after both tests pass.

symbols.name: Nin
symbols.def: The bit length of \(I\), including all legal response rows, source-state decoders, rational polynomial maps, regime-cell maps, query rows, and total orders.

symbols.name: Nout
symbols.def: The bit length of the emitted circuit, exact certificate, obstruction, or invalid-input diagnostic.

symbols.name: Wtrace
symbols.def: The \((2,2,3)\) source-path three-cycle trace defined in \(\text{def:nonbinary-worked-trace}\).

symbols.name: n
symbols.def: Total sample size across supplied regimes.

symbols.name: nr
symbols.def: \(n_r\) is the sample size in regime \(r\), with \(\sum_r n_r=n\).

symbols.name: rho
symbols.def: \(\rho_r=\lim_{n\to\infty}n_r/n\).

symbols.name: phat
symbols.def: The concatenated empirical multinomial proportions \(\widehat p=(\widehat p_r:r\in\mathcal R)\).

symbols.name: Qvec
symbols.type: finite vector of identified query outputs
symbols.def: \(Q=(C_1(p),\ldots,C_d(p))\) for a fixed finite collection of circuits returned by \(\mathsf{SC\mbox{-}CTFID}\).

symbols.name: JQ
symbols.def: \(J_Q(p)=\partial Q/\partial p^{\mathsf T}\), computed by reverse-mode differentiation of the returned circuits.

symbols.name: IF
symbols.def: For a draw in regime \(r\) with cell indicator \(e_x\), \(\varphi_r(x)=\rho_r^{-1}J_{Q,r}(p)(e_x-p_r)\).

symbols.name: Sigma
symbols.def: \(\Sigma_Q=J_Q(p)\operatorname{blockdiag}_{r\in\mathcal R}\{\rho_r^{-1}(\operatorname{diag}(p_r)-p_rp_r^{\mathsf T})\}J_Q(p)^{\mathsf T}\).

symbols.name: CR
symbols.def: The rank-aware Gaussian max-statistic region in \(\text{def:simultaneous-region}\).

assumptions.condition: Every nontrivial directed SCC of \(G\) is an induced chordless directed cycle.

novel.justification: Ring equilibria, reciprocal dyads, and feedback chains closed by one return edge have this structure, while the absence of chords makes legality finitely testable without linearity.

assumptions.condition: Every equivalence class generated by directed-SCC membership and bidirected adjacency contains at most one nontrivial directed SCC.

novel.justification: Separate equilibrium modules often communicate through observed boundary variables while latent dependence remains local to one module; the condition permits arbitrary cycle length and sparse confounding within that module.

standard.name: Semi-Markovian pairwise latent-source incidence with private sources allowed

assumptions.condition: For every \(W\subseteq V\) and assignment to \(V\setminus W\), the retained equations on \(W\) have a unique solution outside one common source-null set.

standard.name: Simple-SCM unique solvability with a finite-alphabet common-null-set formulation
Positive conditioning-event denominator for conditional counterfactual identification

assumptions.condition: Within each \(r\in\mathcal R\), observations are i.i.d. multinomial with probability \(p_r\), and samples are independent across regimes.
\(\min_{1\le j\le d}|D_j(p)|\ge\varepsilon\) for some \(\varepsilon>0\), where \(D_j\) ranges over every divisor in \(C_1,\ldots,C_d\).

standard.name: Positive denominator margin for smooth ratio functionals

definitions.name: \(\mathfrak M_{sc}(G,\operatorname{inc},\mathcal X)\)
definitions.construction: \(\{\mathcal M:\mathcal M\text{ has alphabets }\mathcal X,\text{ graph bounded by }G,\text{ exact source labels and incidence }\operatorname{inc},\text{ and satisfies }\text{ass:chordless-cycle-scc},\text{ ass:one-cycle-per-district},\text{ ass:sparse-source-incidence},\text{ ass:source-independence},\text{ and ass:subset-unique-solvability}\}\)

definitions.name: \(\mathcal L(G,\mathcal X)\)
definitions.construction: \(\{t\in\mathcal T:\text{for every }W\subseteq V\text{ and every boundary assignment }x_{V\setminus W},\text{ the equations induced by }t\text{ on }W\text{ have exactly one solution}\}\)

definitions.name: \(\mathcal F_0(p),\mathcal F_+(p)\)
definitions.construction: \(\Theta_{\mathcal L}=\{\theta\in\prod_{s\in S}\Delta(\Omega_s):\prod_s\lambda_{s,u_s}>0\Rightarrow g(u)\in\mathcal L\}\), \(\mathcal F_0(p)=\{\theta\in\Theta_{\mathcal L}:\Phi(\theta)=p\}\), and \(\mathcal F_+(p)=\{\theta\in\mathcal F_0(p):K(\theta)>0\}\).

definitions.name: Exact source-aware terminal subroutine \(\mathsf{SATerm}\)
definitions.construction: Input is the reached terminal's ordered original-cycle label, boundary rows, \(S,\operatorname{inc},\Omega,\mathcal L,\Phi,H,K\). First enumerate source tuples lexicographically and form the exact polynomials \(\pi_t(\theta)=\sum_{u:g(u)=t}\prod_s\lambda_{s,u_s}\), retaining one simplex block per named source. Use real quantifier elimination on two disjoint copies \(\theta^-,\theta^+\) to decide the formula \(\Phi(\theta^-)=\Phi(\theta^+), K(\theta^-)K(\theta^+)>0, H(\theta^-)K(\theta^+)-H(\theta^+)K(\theta^-)\ne0\), together with legality and every boundary-interface equality. If satisfiable, select the lexicographically first cylindrical algebraic sample cell and emit its minimal polynomials, isolating rational intervals, signs, decoded source tables, and cross-product as \(\Gamma\). If unsatisfiable, compute the lexicographically ordered comprehensive Groebner decomposition of the legal source ideal over \(\mathbb Q[p]\); on every positive component, perform exact function-field membership for \(H/K\), combine equal representatives, and verify the candidate \(C=N/D\) by quantifier elimination of \(K>0\) and \(D(\Phi)H-N(\Phi)K\ne0\) or \(D(\Phi)=0\). Emit \(C\) exactly when both formulas are unsatisfiable. If the separator formula is unsatisfiable but membership or cross-component agreement fails, emit the exact component record \(O\). No unrestricted response-profile simplex, district-level latent consolidation, or row-span substitution occurs.

definitions.name: Executable cycle-label-preserving SC-CTFID specification
definitions.construction: Input is exactly \(I=(V,\mathcal X,G,S,\operatorname{inc},\mathcal R,A,B,\mathcal T,\mathcal L,\Omega,\Phi,H,K)\); \(p\) is not a numerical input, because the output is one symbolic circuit valid uniformly on the full positive feasible image. Validate, in this order, alphabet and index types, graph and source arities, table dimensions, legality bits by direct unique-solution enumeration, and equality of the supplied \(\Phi,H,K\) tables to decoder recomputation; the first failure returns \(\mathsf{invalid}\). Initialize \(\Xi\) with the unnested numerator and denominator worlds, each occurrence labeled by its original SCC, all source labels unmerged, and one root subproblem. Repeatedly pop the lexicographically least stack item and take the first applicable transition: (1) delete a contradictory event row or a duplicate assignment and perform CTFID conditional-factor cancellation; (2) restrict to the ordered source-menu ancestors of the active event; (3) split the ordered consolidated-district partition and push its children in reverse lexicographic order so the least child is processed first; (4) extract the least available regime factor whose intervention set contains the required complement; (5) if the active graph is acyclic, call CTFID with the inherited order and record its formula or acyclic certificate; (6) otherwise isolate the least original-cycle-labeled terminal, materialize its complete boundary primitive-event interface, and call \(\mathsf{SATerm}\); (7) compose returned expressions or glue a returned source-table certificate through the stored interfaces. The state measure is the multiset, under the Dershowitz--Manna extension of lexicographic order, of \(m(\xi)=(w(\xi),d(\xi),a(\xi),e(\xi),h(\xi))\) over pending items: unresolved world occurrences, unresolved consolidated districts, unavailable required regime factors, unmaterialized legal source tuples, and remaining phase rank. Each transition removes one item and inserts only items with a strictly smaller tuple; terminal CAD and Groebner tasks carry their standard finite projection-pair or leading-monomial work list as \(h\), consuming its least element at each internal transition. Branches and monomial orders are lexicographic in the fixed orders on \(V,\mathcal X,S,\mathcal R\). Final outputs are only a verified \(C\), a verified \((\Gamma,\mathcal M^-,\mathcal M^+)\), \(O\), or \(\mathsf{invalid}\).

definitions.name: \(\Gamma\)
definitions.construction: \(\Gamma=(\tau,\ell,S_\ell,\operatorname{inc}_\ell,\Omega_\ell,\theta^-,\theta^+,p^*,I_{\partial},\Delta_q,\mathcal M^-,\mathcal M^+)\), where \(\tau\) is the complete deterministic recursion trace, \(\ell\) is the preserved original-cycle label, each algebraic coordinate of \(\theta^\pm\) has a minimal polynomial and isolating rational interval, \(p^*=\Phi(\theta^-)=\Phi(\theta^+)\), \(I_{\partial}\) lists all matched boundary primitive-event probabilities, and \(\Delta_q=H(\theta^-)K(\theta^+)-H(\theta^+)K(\theta^-)\ne0\).

definitions.name: Exact verifier \(\mathsf{Verify}\)
definitions.construction: Replay \(\tau\) using the fixed branch order; recompute every legality bit by exhaustive intervention and boundary assignment; check every algebraic coordinate by Sturm isolation and every simplex sign exactly; recompute the product-source probabilities without merging source blocks; verify \(\Phi(\theta^-)=\Phi(\theta^+)=p^*\), every row in \(I_{\partial}\), \(K(\theta^-)K(\theta^+)>0\), and the exact sign of \(\Delta_q\); decode both models and recheck their alphabets, source incidence, equations, and subset unique solvability. Accept if and only if every check succeeds.

definitions.name: \(\operatorname{Eval}(C,p)\)
definitions.construction: Return \(\mathsf{infeasible}\) if exact real quantifier elimination finds \(\mathcal F_0(p)=\varnothing\); return \(\mathsf{undefined\mbox{-}zero\mbox{-}denominator}\) if \(\mathcal F_0(p)\ne\varnothing\) and \(\mathcal F_+(p)=\varnothing\); otherwise verify the circuit divisor at \(p\) and return \(C(p)\). Models in \(\mathcal F_0(p)\setminus\mathcal F_+(p)\) have no conditional target and do not enter the identification quantifier.

definitions.name: Complete \((2,2,3)\) source-table trace
definitions.construction: Take the ordered cycle \(1\to2\to3\to1\), \(\mathcal X_1=\mathcal X_2=\{0,1\}\), \(\mathcal X_3=\{0,1,2\}\), and sources \(s_{12},s_{23},e_2\) with incidences \(\{1,2\},\{2,3\},\{2\}\). Enumerate the eight maps \(i:\mathcal X_3\to\mathcal X_1\), four maps \(j:\mathcal X_1\to\mathcal X_2\), and nine maps \(k:\mathcal X_2\to\mathcal X_3\) lexicographically. The legality checker retains exactly the 240 triples for which \(k\circ j\circ i\) has one fixed point and rejects 48. The source interface is \(\pi_{ijk}=a_i c_k b_{j\mid ik}\), with \(a,c\) simplex blocks for \(s_{12},s_{23}\), \(b_{\cdot\mid ik}\) a private-source conditional simplex supported only on retained triples, and boundary rows \(u_a=\sum_i a_i\mathbf1\{i(a)=1\}\) and \(v_b=\sum_k c_k\mathbf1\{k(b)=2\}\). Supply clamp regimes \(\operatorname{do}(X_3=a)\) for \(a=0,1,2\) and \(\operatorname{do}(X_2=b)\) for \(b=0,1\). For each of the four queries \(A_{ab}=\{X_1(X_3=a)=1,X_3(X_2=b)=2\}\), \(a,b\in\{0,1\}\), with \(B\) the sure event, the ordered recursion takes transitions (1), (2), (3), and (6), and \(\mathsf{SATerm}\) returns \(C_{ab}(p)=u_av_b\). Its checker record is \(\mathsf{VALID\_INPUT};\mathsf{LEGAL}=240/288;\mathsf{SOURCES}=(8,9,4\text{ conditional states});\mathsf{SEPARATOR\_QE}=\mathsf{UNSAT};\mathsf{REMAINDER}=0;\mathsf{DIVISOR}=1;\mathsf{INTERFACE}=\mathsf{MATCH};\mathsf{OUTPUT}=u_av_b\). Thus the trace exposes the source-table product interface rather than treating the 240 legal rows as one unrestricted simplex.

definitions.name: \(\widehat Q\)
definitions.construction: \(\widehat Q=(C_1(\widehat p),\ldots,C_d(\widehat p))\), with exact constant coordinates tagged before studentization.

definitions.name: \(\mathcal C_{1-\alpha}\)
definitions.construction: Let \(I_+=\{j:\widehat\Sigma_{Q,jj}>0\}\). On \(I_+\), use the Gaussian plug-in quantile of \(\max_{j\in I_+}|Z_j|/\sqrt{\widehat\Sigma_{Q,jj}}\) for \(Z\sim N(0,\widehat\Sigma_Q)\); report a coordinate outside \(I_+\) as an exact-cell equality only when its circuit simplifies symbolically to a constant, and otherwise as degenerate without a Wald interval.

statements.statement: Perfect intervention and induced-subsystem restriction preserve the property that every nontrivial directed SCC is an induced chordless cycle and every consolidated district contains at most one original cycle; every surviving cyclic SCC retains a unique original-cycle label.
statements.justification: The recursion needs a graph invariant that prevents parallel-world merging from joining two feedback modules.
statements.gap: BongersForrePetersMooij2021, Definition 8.1 and Proposition 8.2, prove closure of simple SCMs under interventions and twinning but do not track original-cycle labels.
statements.consumer: A symbolic implementation can reject an unsafe merge before it corrupts source incidence or cycle identity.

statements.statement: Fix a chordless directed cycle \(v_1\to\cdots\to v_m\to v_1\), a boundary assignment, and a deterministic response profile \(t\). The cycle equations have a unique solution if and only if \(t_{v_m}\circ\cdots\circ t_{v_1}\) has exactly one fixed point; every proper intervention breaks the cycle into uniquely solvable directed paths. For binary unary tables, legality is equivalent to at least one cycle map being constant, and the number of legal profiles is \(4^m-2^m\).
statements.justification: A cardinality-aware terminal must enumerate exactly the response tables compatible with unique feedback equilibria.
statements.gap: BongersForrePetersMooij2021 supplies solvability semantics but not the exact finite fixed-point criterion or binary count for chordless-cycle tables.
statements.consumer: SC-CTFID obtains a finite legality oracle, and the binary regression suite obtains its exact support size.

statements.statement: Every \(\mathcal M\in\mathfrak M_{sc}(G,\operatorname{inc},\mathcal X)\) has a finite-source model \(\widetilde{\mathcal M}\in\mathfrak M_{sc}(G,\operatorname{inc},\mathcal X)\) with the same complete response-profile law and all observational, interventional, and counterfactual distributions, using at most \(|\mathcal T|\) states for each primitive source.
statements.justification: Same-alphabet finite countermodels require source-by-source compression without consolidating independent sources.
statements.gap: ZhangTianBareinboim2022, Theorem 2.4, gives a finite canonical reduction for acyclic SCMs; this claim retains cyclic legality and the original source factorization.
statements.consumer: The negative branch can return inspectable finite models rather than an abstract nonidentification assertion.

statements.statement: For the three-cycle \(X_1=t_1(X_3,U_{12})\), \(X_2=t_2(X_1,U_{12},U_{23},E_2)\), and \(X_3=t_3(X_2,U_{23})\), with independent \(U_{12},U_{23},E_2\), a response-table law \(P(T_1,T_2,T_3)\) is realizable if and only if it is supported on \(\mathcal L\) and \(T_1\perp T_3\). For alphabets \((2,2,3)\), the four cells in \(\text{def:nonbinary-worked-trace}\) therefore equal products of identified clamp-regime marginals although their event rows lie outside the unrestricted legal-profile row span.
statements.justification: This exact terminal shows that source compatibility changes identification rather than merely validating witnesses.
statements.gap: NavascuesWolfe2020 gives an asymptotically complete compatibility hierarchy, while WolfeSpekkensFritz2019 derives polynomial constraints; neither gives this finite legal-cycle equivalence and counterfactual product functional.
statements.consumer: The mixed-alphabet trace prevents cfid from returning false failure under an unrestricted row-space terminal.

statements.statement: The deterministic execution \(Wtrace\) is accepted by the input checker, enumerates exactly 240 legal rows among the 288 \((2,2,3)\) response profiles, preserves the three source blocks and original cycle label, and returns the four circuits \(C_{ab}(p)=P(X_1=1\mid\operatorname{do}(X_3=a))P(X_3=2\mid\operatorname{do}(X_2=b))\) for \(a,b\in\{0,1\}\); the exact checker reports an unsatisfiable separator formula, zero universal remainder, unit divisor, and a matched boundary interface.
statements.justification: A fully typed nonbinary trace makes the source-table terminal and its checker output falsifiable before the general proof is attempted.
statements.gap: No cited cyclic identification algorithm publishes an executable source-factorized trace whose positive result lies outside unrestricted response-row span.
statements.consumer: This is the canonical mixed-alphabet integration test for the cfid implementation and certificate checker.

statements.statement: Let two legal replacements of one source-isolated terminal agree on every complete single-world primitive-equation event indexed by every boundary assignment in the supplied menu. Holding exterior mechanisms and sources fixed makes the global models agree on every coordinate of \(p\); if the certificate carries a transmitting boundary assignment with nonzero target cross-product, their global conditional targets differ.
statements.justification: A local separator proves completeness only if agreement and target separation survive recursive attachment.
statements.gap: LeeCorreaBareinboim2020 glues acyclic witnesses, and RichardsonEvansRobinsShpitser2023 composes acyclic fixing kernels; neither preserves cyclic legality and granular source incidence through this interface.
statements.consumer: The checker can validate a local negative terminal and downstream transmission independently of the search.

statements.statement: For every well-typed explicit instance \(I\), \(\mathsf{SC\mbox{-}CTFID}(I)\) terminates and never returns \(O\). It returns a circuit \(C\) if and only if the following uniform identification condition holds: for every \(p\in\mathcal P_{\mathrm{feas}}\) with \(\mathcal F_+(p)\ne\varnothing\), and all \(\theta,\theta'\in\mathcal F_+(p)\), \(H(\theta)K(\theta')=H(\theta')K(\theta)\). On that branch, \(C(p)=H(\theta)/K(\theta)\) for every such \(p,\theta\). For an exact numerical \(p\notin\mathcal P_{\mathrm{feas}}\), \(\operatorname{Eval}\) returns \(\mathsf{infeasible}\); for \(p\in\mathcal P_{\mathrm{feas}}\) with \(\mathcal F_+(p)=\varnothing\), it returns \(\mathsf{undefined\mbox{-}zero\mbox{-}denominator}\). If uniform identification fails, the algorithm returns a verifier-accepted \((\Gamma,\mathcal M^-,\mathcal M^+)\) with both models in \(\mathfrak M_{sc}(G,\operatorname{inc},\mathcal X)\), the declared alphabets, source incidence, legality, and identical complete laws for every \(r\in\mathcal R\), but positive denominators and unequal values of \(q\).
statements.justification: The formula-or-verifiable-same-class-countermodel dichotomy is the completeness contract absent from cyclic Layer-3 identification.
statements.gap: CorreaLeeBareinboim2021, Algorithms 1--2 and Theorems 5--6, proves this contract for recursive acyclic SCMs; ForreMooij2020, Theorem 9.10 and Remark 9.11, gives sound cyclic interventional identification without completeness.
statements.consumer: The cfid package gains feedback-capable symbolic output or a replayable failure certificate with exact domain statuses.

statements.statement: On explicit input \(I\), every structural transition strictly decreases the multiset measure in \(\text{def:algorithm-handle}\), and every terminal transition consumes the least pending CAD projection pair, sign cell, Groebner critical pair, or leading-monomial task. Hence \(\mathsf{SC\mbox{-}CTFID}\), \(\mathsf{SATerm}\), and \(\mathsf{Verify}\) terminate. Their bit-operation time and working space are at most \(2^{2^{O(N_{in})}}+O(N_{out})\); verification is bounded by the same expression and is polynomial in the explicitly expanded trace and algebraic sign-check work after those are included in \(N_{out}\). No polynomial or singly exponential guarantee is asserted for succinct graph input.
statements.justification: An executable symbolic procedure needs transition-level termination and complexity that charges for exact real elimination.
statements.gap: CorreaLeeBareinboim2021 gives graphical acyclic recursion, whereas the cyclic source-aware terminal requires explicit response tables, CAD, and comprehensive Groebner accounting.
statements.consumer: Package authors can bound exact terminal work, certificate checking, and response expansion separately.

statements.statement: If \(G\) is acyclic, transitions (6)--(7) for cyclic terminals are unreachable, \(O\) cannot occur, and \(\mathsf{SC\mbox{-}CTFID}\) returns exactly the same functional or failure as CTFID on the same unnested query and regime menu.
statements.justification: The standard acyclic special case prevents a competing semantics on familiar inputs.
statements.gap: CorreaLeeBareinboim2021 settles the acyclic case; the strict reduction claim is that every added source-aware cyclic transition is vacuous and the outputs coincide exactly.
statements.consumer: Existing cfid users retain backward-compatible outputs when no directed feedback is present.

statements.statement: For a fixed finite vector \(Q=(C_1(p),\ldots,C_d(p))\) returned by \(\mathsf{SC\mbox{-}CTFID}\), \(\sqrt n(\widehat Q-Q)=n^{-1/2}\sum_{r,i}\varphi_r(X_{ri})+o_P(1)\) and converges to \(N(0,\Sigma_Q)\). The plug-in covariance is consistent, and the rank-aware Gaussian max-statistic region has asymptotic simultaneous coverage \(1-\alpha\) for all positive-variance coordinates. Symbolically constant cells are exact equalities; zero estimated variance without symbolic constancy is reported as degenerate rather than studentized.
statements.justification: Symbolic identification becomes statistically usable when its multi-regime derivatives and degenerate cells are handled automatically.
statements.gap: LiLuedtke2023 derives influence functions for prespecified smooth data-fusion targets, while Tikka2023 returns symbolic acyclic counterfactual formulas without an inference compiler.
statements.consumer: cfid can return estimates, influence functions, joint covariance, and simultaneous regions beside every regular circuit.

statements.statement: Is the obstruction branch \(O\) impossible at every legal source-factorized cyclic terminal reached by the deterministic recursion, and does every satisfiable two-copy separator returned by \(\mathsf{SATerm}\) admit the boundary-interface transmission required to decode two same-alphabet models with the original source incidence? Equivalently, can comprehensive componentwise function-field descent always produce one rational circuit when the uniform two-copy separator formula is unsatisfiable, while every satisfiable formula survives recursive gluing?
statements.justification: Constancy on real semialgebraic source fibers need not automatically descend to one rational function, and local separation can vanish after attachment.
statements.gap: LeeSpekkens2017 gives rational recovery in selected small structures and NavascuesWolfe2020 gives asymptotically complete compatibility, but neither proves rational descent with finite same-class separators and cyclic interfaces.
statements.consumer: A positive answer completes SC-CTFID; a concrete obstruction identifies the necessary enlargement of its output language.

sampling_model.design: A fixed finite menu \(\mathcal R\) of observational and perfect-interventional regimes is supplied; symbolic identification is uniform over its full feasible image.
sampling_model.units: For inference, regime \(r\) supplies \(n_r\) i.i.d. finite-alphabet draws, independently across regimes.
sampling_model.treatment: Each regime clamps a declared endogenous subset \(Z\) to \(z\) and records the complete joint outcome on \(V\setminus Z\).
sampling_model.overlap: Evaluation distinguishes infeasible menu vectors and feasible vectors with no positive-denominator model; inference additionally imposes a fixed circuit margin and positive limiting regime fractions.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: No infinite-dimensional nuisance is estimated; empirical multinomial cells pass through the verified rational circuit by automatic differentiation.

estimand_functional: \(C(p)=H(\theta)/K(\theta)\) for every \(p\in\mathcal P_{\mathrm{feas}}\) with \(\mathcal F_+(p)\ne\varnothing\) and every \(\theta\in\mathcal F_+(p)\)

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: Algorithms 1--2 and Theorems 5--6 are sound and complete for marginal and conditional counterfactual identification from arbitrary observational and experimental inputs in recursive acyclic SCMs.
Theorem 9.10 proves soundness of an extended ID algorithm for cyclic ioSCM interventional effects, and Remark 9.11 makes no completeness claim.
Theorem 2.4 gives finite canonical acyclic SCMs, and the paper reduces counterfactual bounds to polynomial optimization.
The inflation hierarchy converges asymptotically to the compatible set for finite latent causal structures.
Theorem 2 and Corollary 1 characterize source-aligned influence functions and canonical gradients for prespecified smooth data-fusion targets.

tldr: Finite-alphabet simple SCMs permit counterfactuals under feedback, but complete conditional counterfactual algorithms are acyclic and cyclic algorithms stop at sound interventional identification. SC-CTFID is a deterministic cycle-label- and source-incidence-preserving recursion on explicit legal response tables. It emits one rational circuit uniformly over the positive feasible menu image exactly when the conditional target is uniformly identified, and otherwise emits two verifier-accepted same-alphabet simple SCMs matching every supplied law. Its terminal retains the product of named source simplices, uses exact two-copy real elimination and function-field descent, and exposes any nonrational constant-fiber component as a diagnostic whose impossibility is the open kernel. A complete \((2,2,3)\) trace displays the 240-row legality filter and four source-induced product circuits. Returned circuits compile to multinomial influence functions and simultaneous regions, with infeasible, zero-denominator, exact, and degenerate inputs separated.

project_justification.gap: CorreaLeeBareinboim2021 proves complete conditional counterfactual identification for recursive SCMs, while BongersForrePetersMooij2021 supplies cyclic simple-SCM semantics and ForreMooij2020 proves only sound cyclic interventional identification. None gives an executable Layer-3 terminal that respects fixed-point legality and granular independent sources, states the full feasible-image quantifiers, or returns checkable same-class witnesses.
project_justification.niche: One induced chordless cycle per consolidated district permits nontrivial feedback and sparse confounding while admitting exact legality enumeration, preserved cycle labels, and finite source-polynomial elimination.
project_justification.fill: SC-CTFID combines CTFID cancellation with an ordered cyclic recursion, explicit source-aware CAD and Groebner elimination, exact certificate replay, boundary-preserving witness gluing, and automatic inference for verified rational circuits.

related_work: CorreaLeeBareinboim2021, Sections 3--4 and Theorems 5--6, supplies the acyclic formula-or-failure template and conditional cancellation; Theorem 6 gives exact reduction to it when the cyclic transitions are unreachable. BongersForrePetersMooij2021, Definition 8.1 and Proposition 8.2, supplies simple-SCM solvability and intervention and twin closure but not identification. ForreMooij2020, Proposition 9.8, Theorem 9.10, and Remark 9.11, informs consolidated-district extraction for cyclic ioSCMs but stops short of completeness and Layer-3 queries. ZhangTianBareinboim2022, Theorem 2.4 and Section 3, informs finite response parametrization and polynomial counterfactual objectives in acyclic graphs. NavascuesWolfe2020 proves asymptotic completeness of inflation, while WolfeSpekkensFritz2019 shows that independent sources impose polynomial restrictions beyond conditional independence; neither supplies a fixed exact rational terminal. LeeSpekkens2017 demonstrates Groebner feasibility and rational recovery in small functional structures. ShpitserPearl2008 and LeeCorreaBareinboim2020 supply acyclic countermodel constructions, and RichardsonEvansRobinsShpitser2023 supplies composable fixing kernels; the boundary lemma must additionally preserve cycle legality and primitive-source labels. LiLuedtke2023 informs the source-decomposed influence-function calculation, and Tikka2023 documents cfid as the direct acyclic symbolic consumer.
technical_internal_limitation: The input explicitly lists response and source tables and can be exponentially larger than the graph. Exact real and comprehensive Groebner elimination justify only a doubly exponential worst-case bound. The rational-circuit theorem requires proving that the diagnostic obstruction \(O\) is unreachable; a uniformly identified algebraic but nonrational target would refute that contract without invalidating the executable diagnostic. The inference theorem is fixed-dimensional and pointwise on positive-margin strata; nonsymbolic zero-variance coordinates receive no Wald interval.
honest_scope: The fixed-point legality theorem, finite-source compression, latent-path realizability, worked trace, boundary gluing, global recursion, rational terminal descent, transition measure, complexity bound, and circuit inference are proof obligations. The \((2,2,3)\) enumeration, binary regression suite, rational separators, two-district transmitter, and CHSH rejection are computational evidence, not proofs. The open question is whether the exact terminal can ever return \(O\) and whether every local separator transmits. The acyclic reduction must reproduce CTFID exactly. A false failure on a product-identified trace cell, an illegal or source-merging certificate, a failed transmitter, or a nonrational uniformly identified target stops the program.

literature_map: The kernel joins complete acyclic counterfactual identification, cyclic simple-SCM semantics, finite algebraic source compatibility, and witness composition. Correa--Lee--Bareinboim and Shpitser--Pearl provide acyclic conditional identification and explicit failure semantics. Bongers--Forré--Peters--Mooij and Forré--Mooij provide cyclic solvability and sound consolidated-district recursion but no Layer-3 completeness. Zhang--Tian--Bareinboim, Lee--Spekkens, Wolfe--Spekkens--Fritz, and Navascués--Wolfe motivate finite polynomial response models and source constraints, while leaving open a fixed rational terminal on legal cyclic fibers. Richardson--Evans--Robins--Shpitser and Lee--Correa--Bareinboim provide acyclic composition and gluing but not preservation of fixed points and named sources. Tikka is the direct software consumer, and Li--Luedtke supplies the secondary influence-function template.

novelty_justification: CorreaLeeBareinboim2021, Theorems 5--6, is the closest comparator: it proves the same uniform formula-or-failure contract for recursive SCMs, and Theorem 6 here recovers that result exactly on acyclic inputs. The first nontransferable step is parallel-world consolidation, because copies of an original feedback cycle can form distinct expanded SCCs and district consolidation can erase independent sources. ForreMooij2020, Theorem 9.10 and Remark 9.11, is the second comparator: it handles cyclic interventional effects but proves only soundness and has neither conditional counterfactuals nor negative witnesses. The source terminal here is executable: it enumerates legal source tuples, runs an exact two-copy separator test, performs componentwise rational descent, verifies circuits universally, and emits algebraic same-class witnesses or an explicit descent obstruction. The \((2,2,3)\) trace shows four product-identified cells outside unrestricted row span, while the CHSH obstruction rules out legal-support gluing. The kernel is therefore neither cycle contraction nor unrestricted response-table elimination.
